methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing or product page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. ElevenLabs: elevenlabs.io/pricing — page rendered with full plan data. Murf.ai: murf.ai/pricing returned JS-only blank page; pricing sourced from murf.ai/text-to-speech product page which displays annual rates. WellSaid Labs: wellsaidlabs.com/pricing redirects to wellsaid.io/pricing — full data retrieved. Resemble AI: resemble.ai/pricing returned full pay-as-you-go rate card. Speechify: speechify.com/pricing rendered plan names and monthly price; annual rate only partially visible ('SAVE 60%'); sourceforge.net corroboration confirmed $139/year. Amazon Polly: aws.amazon.com/polly/pricing — full per-character rate card retrieved. Play.ht: play.ht domain refused all connections (ECONNREFUSED); multiple aggregator and review URLs also failed or returned 403/404; only a starting price of $29/mo was found in a secondary review article (elegantthemes.com) — insufficient to include with verified tier structure, excluded from dataset. monthlyUsd for usage-metered plans with no flat subscription is set to null (Resemble Flex, Amazon Polly). annualDiscountPct computed where both monthly and annual rates are confirmed.

vendors.name: ElevenLabs
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page: https://elevenlabs.io/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Enterprise compliance page: https://elevenlabs.io/enterprise fetched 2026-06-14 (HIPAA-eligible configurations, BAA available, integrations list).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 10,000 credits/month. Text-to-speech, speech-to-text, sound effects, voice design included.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 30,000 credits/month. Adds commercial license and voice cloning.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: 121,000 credits/month. Professional voice cloning. Promotional first-month price of $11 (50% off) was shown on page at time of access.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 600,000 credits/month. 44.1kHz PCM and 192kbps audio output via API.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: 1,800,000 credits/month. Includes 3 workspace seats.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: 6,000,000 credits/month. 10 workspace seats. Low-latency TTS as low as $0.05/min.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom credits and seats. Includes BAA for HIPAA, HIPAA-eligible configuration, custom SLAs.

vendors.name: Murf AI
vendors.provenance: murf.ai/pricing rendered JS-only blank page (fallback used). Pricing sourced from murf.ai/text-to-speech product page, fetched 2026-06-14, which displays annual billing rates for Creator and Business plans. Month-to-month rates not published on either page. Corroborating starting price of $19/month confirmed via elegantthemes.com best-ai-voice-generators article (fetched 2026-06-14).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 2 projects, 10 minutes of voice generation. 200+ voices.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: Price is $19/month billed annually; month-to-month rate not published on official page. API pricing $0.01/min for Murf Falcon model.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Price is $66/month billed annually; month-to-month rate not published on official page.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing for high-volume and specialized business requirements. Contact sales.

vendors.name: WellSaid Labs
vendors.provenance: wellsaidlabs.com/pricing redirected (301) to wellsaid.io/pricing, fetched 2026-06-14. All plan tiers and prices read directly from official page. HIPAA not mentioned on pricing page.

plans.name: Trial
plans.notes: 7-day free access to all features. No credit card required. No downloads included.

plans.name: Creative
plans.notes: $55/month billed monthly; $50/month billed annually (~9% discount). Per user seat. 720 downloads/year (~72 hours audio). Includes commercial usage rights.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $160/month per user billed annually. Up to 5 user seats. 1,300 downloads/year (~144 hours). Includes Adobe Express & Premiere Pro integrations. Month-to-month rate not published.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing billed annually. Unlimited seats. 4,300 downloads/year (~480 hours). Advanced security: SOC2, SSO. Dedicated customer success manager.

vendors.name: Resemble AI
vendors.provenance: resemble.ai/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Full pay-as-you-go rate card retrieved. Enterprise plan confirmed quote-only. SOC 2 mentioned for Enterprise. HIPAA not mentioned.

plans.name: Flex
plans.notes: Pay-as-you-go with no base subscription fee. TTS rate: $0.0005/second. Voice agents: $0.001/second. AI voice changer: $0.0005/second. Team seats add-on: $20/month per user. Rapid voice clone add-on: $2/month per voice. Pro voice clone add-on: $5/month per voice. Users spending over $500/month recommended to contact sales.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Volume discounts up to 80%. Enterprise SLAs, SOC 2 compliance. Contact sales.

vendors.name: Speechify
vendors.provenance: speechify.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Monthly price of $29 for Premium confirmed from official page. Annual pricing shows 'SAVE 60%' but exact dollar amount not rendered; sourceforge.net product listing corroborated $139/year ($11.58/month equivalent).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Listen at up to 1.5x speed. 10 robotic voices. Text-to-speech only.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $29/month billed monthly. Annual billing saves approximately 60%; corroborating source indicates ~$139/year (~$11.58/month). 1000+ natural voices, 60+ languages, voice typing, AI summaries, AI podcasts, voice AI assistant.

vendors.name: Amazon Polly
vendors.provenance: aws.amazon.com/polly/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Per-character rates confirmed directly from AWS pricing page. HIPAA certification and BAA availability confirmed via docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/what-is.html (fetched 2026-06-14): 'Amazon Polly is certified for use with regulated workloads for HIPAA and PCI DSS.'

plans.name: Standard Voices
plans.notes: Pay-per-use: $4.00 per 1 million characters. Free tier: 5 million characters/month (no expiry). No flat monthly subscription.

plans.name: Neural Voices

plans.name: Long-Form Voices

plans.name: Generative Voices
